description: ICIMOD Regional Database System is a database run by International Centre for Integrated Mountain Development (ICIMOD). The regional database system hosts geospatial data sets of the Hindu Kush Himalaya, including land cover, glacier and glacial lake inventories, flood and landslide data and infrastructure layers such as roads and hydropower. Coverage: Hindu Kush Himalaya (eight countries). It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as geotiff, shp; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("Home | Regional Database System | ICIMOD") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support mountain hazard and hydropower infrastructure studies in the Himalaya. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
